name: San Francisco Bay Area
_comment_counties: The nine ABAG counties. Named so the bbox can be argued with rather than trusted.
_comment_bbox: Wider than the county polygons on purpose: a route may legitimately leave the region and come back, and an edge clipped mid-way is worse than a few extra square kilometres of graph. West to the Farallones, south past Santa Cruz's approach roads, north over the Sonoma/Napa county line, east to the Altamont.
_comment_counts: Recorded from a real extract, not invented. ops/sane asserts each class stays inside its bounds; a filter change that silently drops a class fails there instead of surfacing as a bad route weeks later. Regenerate deliberately with ops/etl-extract --record-counts.
